question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Hesitation
solution: The correct answer is** "Reluctance."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Hesitation** means a pause or delay in action, often due to uncertainty or doubt. (कार्रवाई में रुकावट या देरी, अक्सर अनिश्चितता या संदेह के कारण) • **Example**: *She agreed without a moment’s **hesitation**__.* • Synonyms of **reluctance** include **hesitation, unwillingness, and reticence**. • **Reluctance** means a hesitation or unwillingness to do something. (कार्य-विशेष के प्रति अनिच्‍छा या हिचक) __ • **Example**: *Tony left with obvious **reluctance**__.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Readiness**, means being prepared or willing to do something without hesitation. ((किसी बात के लिए) तत्‍परता या मुस्‍तैदी) • **Option 3, Prudence**, means being cautious and careful in decision-making, not necessarily related to hesitation. (निर्णय लेने में सतर्क और सावधान रहना) • **Option 4, Creativity**, means the ability to come up with original and imaginative ideas, not related to hesitation. (सृजन-क्षमता) 32:Tcb5, The correct answer is **"express."**
